body.content:
# .github/workflows/udp.yml — sinh bởi UDP (Golden Path, §11)
# Rollout: udp-driven — deploy chỉ áp image, flag vẫn tắt; bật dần flag trên Portal
name: UDP CI/CD
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, dev, staging]
  # [Plan #61 QĐ-13] Vá image nền (rebase) mỗi ngày lúc 03:15 UTC — lượt này chỉ chạy job rebase
  schedule:
    - cron: "15 3 * * *"
permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write
  packages: write
jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    if: github.event_name != 'schedule'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      IMAGE_REF: ghcr.io/acme/p-0be07262:${{ github.sha }}
      UDP_TRACKED_FLAGS: ""
    steps:
      - name: Chọn environment theo nhánh
        run: |
          echo "UDP_ENVIRONMENT=$([ "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" = "main" ] && echo "prod" || echo "$GITHUB_REF_NAME")" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Test
        run: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/w" -w /w node:22.23.3-alpine@sha256:0a7108bf6c7bf5de370ffb1a3ed6be93d405b43ff159f681a8d18c0e2bc2e402 sh -c "npm ci && npm test"
      - name: Build và đẩy image
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -eu
          UDP_TMP="$RUNNER_TEMP/udp-build"
          mkdir -p "$UDP_TMP"
          if [ -f "./Dockerfile" ]; then UDP_STRATEGY=dockerfile; else UDP_STRATEGY=buildpacks; fi
          echo "UDP build: $UDP_STRATEGY (co ./Dockerfile thi Dockerfile, khong thi Buildpacks)"
          printf '%s' "$GITHUB_TOKEN" | docker login --username "$GITHUB_ACTOR" --password-stdin ghcr.io
          if [ "$UDP_STRATEGY" = dockerfile ]; then
            docker buildx create --name udp-build --driver docker-container --use >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker buildx use udp-build
            docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --file "./Dockerfile" --tag "ghcr.io/acme/p-0be07262:$GITHUB_SHA" --push --sbom=true --provenance=mode=max --cache-from "type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/acme/p-0be07262:udp-cache-buildkit" --cache-to "type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/acme/p-0be07262:udp-cache-buildkit,mode=max,image-manifest=true,oci-mediatypes=true" --metadata-file "$UDP_TMP/build-meta.json" "."
            UDP_DIGEST=$(grep -o '"containerimage.digest": *"sha256:[0-9a-f]*"' "$UDP_TMP/build-meta.json" | grep -oE 'sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}' | head -n 1)
          else
            curl -fsSL -o "$UDP_TMP/pack.tgz" "https://github.com/buildpacks/pack/releases/download/v0.40.9/pack-v0.40.9-linux.tgz"
            echo "dc0ee1e931cf8a106d7555a01a214864f9acb60b77adf15d69b74df4404758e9  $UDP_TMP/pack.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
            tar -xzf "$UDP_TMP/pack.tgz" -C "$UDP_TMP" pack
            rm -rf "$UDP_TMP/app" && mkdir -p "$UDP_TMP/app"
            tar -C "." --exclude=./.git -cf - . | tar -C "$UDP_TMP/app" -xf -
            "$UDP_TMP/pack" build "ghcr.io/acme/p-0be07262:$GITHUB_SHA" --builder paketobuildpacks/ubuntu-noble-builder:0.0.201@sha256:46786dec16ff7908c938b6a8153f3bf58babe0f73885beb477bff8a7a6fc8807 --trust-builder --path "$UDP_TMP/app" --platform linux/amd64 --publish --cache-image "ghcr.io/acme/p-0be07262:udp-cache-cnb" --report-output-dir "$UDP_TMP/report"
            UDP_DIGEST=$(grep -E '^ *digest *= *"sha256:' "$UDP_TMP/report/report.toml" | grep -oE 'sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}' | head -n 1)
          fi
          [ -n "$UDP_DIGEST" ] || { echo "Khong doc duoc digest cua image vua day"; exit 1; }
          UDP_IMAGE_REF="ghcr.io/acme/p-0be07262:$GITHUB_SHA@$UDP_DIGEST"
          echo "UDP image: $UDP_IMAGE_REF"
          echo "IMAGE_REF=$UDP_IMAGE_REF" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Ký image
        run: |
          UDP_DIGEST="${IMAGE_REF##*@}"
          set -eu
          UDP_TMP="$RUNNER_TEMP/udp-sign"
          mkdir -p "$UDP_TMP"
          UDP_OIDC_TOKEN=$(curl -sSf -G --data-urlencode "audience=sts.amazonaws.com" -H "Authorization: bearer $ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN" "$ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL" | jq -r .value)
          printf '%s' "$UDP_OIDC_TOKEN" > /tmp/udp-sign-oidc
          export AWS_ROLE_ARN=arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/udp/udp-build-x AWS_ROLE_SESSION_NAME=udp-sign AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE=/tmp/udp-sign-oidc AWS_REGION=eu-west-1
          curl -fsSL -o "$UDP_TMP/cosign" "https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/releases/download/v3.1.3/cosign-linux-amd64"
          echo "4629c757b7618056f8ddd7e2625ae9fdd94c0372a65049520bc7d9df9efc7f71  $UDP_TMP/cosign" | sha256sum -c -
          chmod +x "$UDP_TMP/cosign"
          curl -fsSL -o "$UDP_TMP/oras.tgz" "https://github.com/oras-project/oras/releases/download/v1.3.4/oras_1.3.4_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
          echo "f27adb935022d94df8dc77719c322dda592c78a0d57a6f7dcdd8d900b248c454  $UDP_TMP/oras.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar -xzf "$UDP_TMP/oras.tgz" -C "$UDP_TMP" oras
          printf '%s' '{"mediaType":"application/vnd.dev.sigstore.signingconfig.v0.2+json","rekorTlogConfig":{},"tsaConfig":{}}' > "$UDP_TMP/signing-config.json"
          UDP_ISSUED_AT=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          "$UDP_TMP/cosign" sign --yes --key "awskms:///arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/0f1e2d3c-4b5a-6978-8796-a5b4c3d2e1f0" --signing-config "$UDP_TMP/signing-config.json" --bundle "$UDP_TMP/signature.json" -a dev.udp.project=p-0be07262 -a dev.udp.commit=$GITHUB_SHA -a dev.udp.ref=$GITHUB_REF_NAME -a dev.udp.run=$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT -a dev.udp.issued-at="$UDP_ISSUED_AT" "ghcr.io/acme/p-0be07262@$UDP_DIGEST"
          UDP_DIGEST_HEX=$(printf '%s' "$UDP_DIGEST" | sed 's/^sha256://')
          printf '{"critical":{"identity":{"docker-reference":"%s"},"image":{"docker-manifest-digest":"%s"},"type":"cosign container image signature"},"optional":{"dev.udp.project":"%s","dev.udp.commit":"%s","dev.udp.ref":"%s","dev.udp.run":"%s","dev.udp.issued-at":"%s"}}' "ghcr.io/acme/p-0be07262" "$UDP_DIGEST" "p-0be07262" "$GITHUB_SHA" "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" "$UDP_ISSUED_AT" > "$UDP_TMP/simple-signing.json"
          "$UDP_TMP/cosign" sign-blob --yes --key "awskms:///arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/0f1e2d3c-4b5a-6978-8796-a5b4c3d2e1f0" --signing-config "$UDP_TMP/signing-config.json" --bundle "$UDP_TMP/simple-signing.bundle.json" "$UDP_TMP/simple-signing.json"
          UDP_SIMPLE_SIG=$(jq -r .messageSignature.signature "$UDP_TMP/simple-signing.bundle.json")
          printf '{"simple-signing.json":{"dev.cosignproject.cosign/signature":"%s"}}' "$UDP_SIMPLE_SIG" > "$UDP_TMP/simple-signing.annotations.json"
          printf '%s' '{"architecture":"","os":"","config":{},"rootfs":{"type":"layers","diff_ids":[]}}' > "$UDP_TMP/simple-signing.config.json"
          cd "$UDP_TMP" && ./oras push "ghcr.io/acme/p-0be07262:sha256-$UDP_DIGEST_HEX.sig" --config simple-signing.config.json:application/vnd.oci.image.config.v1+json --annotation-file simple-signing.annotations.json simple-signing.json:application/vnd.dev.cosign.simplesigning.v1+json && cd - >/dev/null
          UDP_SIGNATURE_B64=$(base64 -w 0 < "$UDP_TMP/signature.json")
          echo "UDP signed: ghcr.io/acme/p-0be07262@$UDP_DIGEST"
          rm -f /tmp/udp-sign-oidc /tmp/udp-sign-oidc.json
          echo "UDP_SIGNATURE_B64=$UDP_SIGNATURE_B64" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Báo UDP
        if: always()
        env:
          UDP_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ vars.UDP_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          UDP_WEBHOOK_SECRET: ${{ secrets.UDP_WEBHOOK_SECRET }}
          UDP_STATUS: ${{ job.status == 'success' && 'success' || 'failure' }}
          COMMIT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          COMMIT_TS: ${{ github.event.head_commit.timestamp }}
          PIPELINE_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          ACTOR: ${{ github.actor }}
        run: |
          [ "$UDP_STATUS" = "success" ] || IMAGE_REF=""
          BODY=$(jq -nc \
            --arg env "$UDP_ENVIRONMENT" --arg status "$UDP_STATUS" \
            --arg sha "$COMMIT_SHA" --arg ts "$COMMIT_TS" --arg image "$IMAGE_REF" \
            --arg wl "p-0be07262" --arg run "$PIPELINE_ID" --arg repo "$REPO" \
            --arg ref "$REF" --arg actor "$ACTOR" --arg kind "${UDP_KIND:-}" \
            --arg sig "${UDP_SIGNATURE_B64:-}" \
            '{environment:$env, status:$status, commitSha:$sha, commitTimestamp:$ts,
              imageRef:$image, workloadName:$wl, pipelineId:$run, repo:$repo, ref:$ref,
              actor:$actor, kind:$kind,
              signature:(if $sig == "" then "" else ($sig | @base64d | fromjson) end)}
              | with_entries(select(.value != ""))')
          SIG=$(printf '%s' "$BODY" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$UDP_WEBHOOK_SECRET" -hex | sed 's/^.* //')
          curl -sS --fail -X POST "$UDP_WEBHOOK_URL" \
            -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
            -H "X-Hub-Signature-256: sha256=$SIG" \
            --data-binary "$BODY"
  rebase:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: main
      - name: Rebase image nền và báo UDP
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          UDP_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ vars.UDP_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          UDP_WEBHOOK_SECRET: ${{ secrets.UDP_WEBHOOK_SECRET }}
          PIPELINE_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          ACTOR: ${{ github.actor }}
        run: |
          COMMIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          set -eu
          UDP_TMP="$RUNNER_TEMP/udp-rebase"
          mkdir -p "$UDP_TMP"
          if [ -f "./Dockerfile" ]; then UDP_STRATEGY=dockerfile; else UDP_STRATEGY=buildpacks; fi
          echo "UDP build: $UDP_STRATEGY (co ./Dockerfile thi Dockerfile, khong thi Buildpacks)"
          if [ "$UDP_STRATEGY" != buildpacks ]; then echo "Image dung bang Dockerfile: rebase chi ap cho image Buildpacks. Cap nhat FROM roi build lai de lay ban va cua image nen"; exit 0; fi
          printf '%s' "$GITHUB_TOKEN" | docker login --username "$GITHUB_ACTOR" --password-stdin ghcr.io
          curl -fsSL -o "$UDP_TMP/pack.tgz" "https://github.com/buildpacks/pack/releases/download/v0.40.9/pack-v0.40.9-linux.tgz"
          echo "dc0ee1e931cf8a106d7555a01a214864f9acb60b77adf15d69b74df4404758e9  $UDP_TMP/pack.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar -xzf "$UDP_TMP/pack.tgz" -C "$UDP_TMP" pack
          "$UDP_TMP/pack" rebase "ghcr.io/acme/p-0be07262:$COMMIT_SHA" --publish --report-output-dir "$UDP_TMP/report"
          UDP_DIGEST=$(grep -E '^ *digest *= *"sha256:' "$UDP_TMP/report/report.toml" | grep -oE 'sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}' | head -n 1)
          [ -n "$UDP_DIGEST" ] || { echo "Khong doc duoc digest cua image vua rebase"; exit 1; }
          UDP_IMAGE_REF="ghcr.io/acme/p-0be07262:$COMMIT_SHA@$UDP_DIGEST"
          echo "UDP rebase: $UDP_IMAGE_REF"
          UDP_DIGEST="${UDP_IMAGE_REF##*@}"
          set -eu
          UDP_TMP="$RUNNER_TEMP/udp-sign"
          mkdir -p "$UDP_TMP"
          UDP_OIDC_TOKEN=$(curl -sSf -G --data-urlencode "audience=sts.amazonaws.com" -H "Authorization: bearer $ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN" "$ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL" | jq -r .value)
          printf '%s' "$UDP_OIDC_TOKEN" > /tmp/udp-sign-oidc
          export AWS_ROLE_ARN=arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/udp/udp-build-x AWS_ROLE_SESSION_NAME=udp-sign AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE=/tmp/udp-sign-oidc AWS_REGION=eu-west-1
          curl -fsSL -o "$UDP_TMP/cosign" "https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/releases/download/v3.1.3/cosign-linux-amd64"
          echo "4629c757b7618056f8ddd7e2625ae9fdd94c0372a65049520bc7d9df9efc7f71  $UDP_TMP/cosign" | sha256sum -c -
          chmod +x "$UDP_TMP/cosign"
          curl -fsSL -o "$UDP_TMP/oras.tgz" "https://github.com/oras-project/oras/releases/download/v1.3.4/oras_1.3.4_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
          echo "f27adb935022d94df8dc77719c322dda592c78a0d57a6f7dcdd8d900b248c454  $UDP_TMP/oras.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar -xzf "$UDP_TMP/oras.tgz" -C "$UDP_TMP" oras
          printf '%s' '{"mediaType":"application/vnd.dev.sigstore.signingconfig.v0.2+json","rekorTlogConfig":{},"tsaConfig":{}}' > "$UDP_TMP/signing-config.json"
          UDP_ISSUED_AT=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          "$UDP_TMP/cosign" sign --yes --key "awskms:///arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/0f1e2d3c-4b5a-6978-8796-a5b4c3d2e1f0" --signing-config "$UDP_TMP/signing-config.json" --bundle "$UDP_TMP/signature.json" -a dev.udp.project=p-0be07262 -a dev.udp.commit=$COMMIT_SHA -a dev.udp.ref=main -a dev.udp.run=$PIPELINE_ID -a dev.udp.issued-at="$UDP_ISSUED_AT" "ghcr.io/acme/p-0be07262@$UDP_DIGEST"
          UDP_DIGEST_HEX=$(printf '%s' "$UDP_DIGEST" | sed 's/^sha256://')
          printf '{"critical":{"identity":{"docker-reference":"%s"},"image":{"docker-manifest-digest":"%s"},"type":"cosign container image signature"},"optional":{"dev.udp.project":"%s","dev.udp.commit":"%s","dev.udp.ref":"%s","dev.udp.run":"%s","dev.udp.issued-at":"%s"}}' "ghcr.io/acme/p-0be07262" "$UDP_DIGEST" "p-0be07262" "$COMMIT_SHA" "main" "$PIPELINE_ID" "$UDP_ISSUED_AT" > "$UDP_TMP/simple-signing.json"
          "$UDP_TMP/cosign" sign-blob --yes --key "awskms:///arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/0f1e2d3c-4b5a-6978-8796-a5b4c3d2e1f0" --signing-config "$UDP_TMP/signing-config.json" --bundle "$UDP_TMP/simple-signing.bundle.json" "$UDP_TMP/simple-signing.json"
          UDP_SIMPLE_SIG=$(jq -r .messageSignature.signature "$UDP_TMP/simple-signing.bundle.json")
          printf '{"simple-signing.json":{"dev.cosignproject.cosign/signature":"%s"}}' "$UDP_SIMPLE_SIG" > "$UDP_TMP/simple-signing.annotations.json"
          printf '%s' '{"architecture":"","os":"","config":{},"rootfs":{"type":"layers","diff_ids":[]}}' > "$UDP_TMP/simple-signing.config.json"
          cd "$UDP_TMP" && ./oras push "ghcr.io/acme/p-0be07262:sha256-$UDP_DIGEST_HEX.sig" --config simple-signing.config.json:application/vnd.oci.image.config.v1+json --annotation-file simple-signing.annotations.json simple-signing.json:application/vnd.dev.cosign.simplesigning.v1+json && cd - >/dev/null
          UDP_SIGNATURE_B64=$(base64 -w 0 < "$UDP_TMP/signature.json")
          echo "UDP signed: ghcr.io/acme/p-0be07262@$UDP_DIGEST"
          rm -f /tmp/udp-sign-oidc /tmp/udp-sign-oidc.json
          UDP_STATUS=success UDP_KIND=rebase UDP_ENVIRONMENT=prod IMAGE_REF="$UDP_IMAGE_REF" COMMIT_TS= REF=refs/heads/main
          BODY=$(jq -nc \
            --arg env "$UDP_ENVIRONMENT" --arg status "$UDP_STATUS" \
            --arg sha "$COMMIT_SHA" --arg ts "$COMMIT_TS" --arg image "$IMAGE_REF" \
            --arg wl "p-0be07262" --arg run "$PIPELINE_ID" --arg repo "$REPO" \
            --arg ref "$REF" --arg actor "$ACTOR" --arg kind "${UDP_KIND:-}" \
            --arg sig "${UDP_SIGNATURE_B64:-}" \
            '{environment:$env, status:$status, commitSha:$sha, commitTimestamp:$ts,
              imageRef:$image, workloadName:$wl, pipelineId:$run, repo:$repo, ref:$ref,
              actor:$actor, kind:$kind,
              signature:(if $sig == "" then "" else ($sig | @base64d | fromjson) end)}
              | with_entries(select(.value != ""))')
          SIG=$(printf '%s' "$BODY" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$UDP_WEBHOOK_SECRET" -hex | sed 's/^.* //')
          curl -sS --fail -X POST "$UDP_WEBHOOK_URL" \
            -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
            -H "X-Hub-Signature-256: sha256=$SIG" \
            --data-binary "$BODY"
